text.content:
Junk chrome and throat speakers at the Totentanz door.

Turf: Northside Industrial
Known for: Junk chrome bolted on; cheap speakers in their throats
Allies & rivals: Patron: Maelstrom

Northside kids who gather at the Totentanz door and sing, hoping Maelstrom picks them. Most of Maelstrom's initiates come from the Choir. The ones who aren't picked tend to end up on a Scavenger's table.

Night City 2070 (The Unification Era), ch.04
